overview: We test the connections between your app and the outside tools it depends on, then fix the weak spots. We list every integration, run normal and unusual cases such as timeouts, empty answers and duplicate messages, and record what happens. You receive a clear test report, and we improve error handling so one failing service shows a friendly message instead of crashing the whole screen.

faq: Do you test with real customer data?
No. We use test accounts, sandbox modes and made-up records wherever the tool offers them. If a tool has no sandbox, we agree a safe plan with you first.
Will testing cause real charges or emails?
We avoid it. Payment and email tools are tested in their test modes, and we turn off live sending. We tell you in advance about anything that could not be tested safely.
Can you test an integration someone else built?
Yes. Add us to the project and share the integration list. We read the code only as much as needed to test it and we report findings in plain language.
What if you find a lot of problems?
We rank them by risk. The package fixes what its limit allows, and anything beyond that is listed with a clear estimate so you can decide what to do next.
